## Current Install Shape

Install the package into a ConfigHub Space, which renders it and uploads
one Unit per resource:

```sh
cub package install longhorn:v1.12.1 --space longhorn --base <variant> --namespace <namespace>
```

Or render it locally from the exact package bytes, with no Space:

```sh
cub installer setup --pull oci://ghcr.io/confighub/packages/longhorn:v1.12.1@sha256:617b2aa407c54c4a645624bbc05a1e4cf3aa44c762684e06d6ba4bfebaebb6b5 --base <variant> --work-dir <tmp> --non-interactive --namespace <namespace>
```

Use the variant table above to choose the package base. The `oci://` ref is
the public package users pull, signed by the package publish workflow; check it with
`cosign verify --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/confighub/helm-expt/.github/workflows/packages-publish.yml@refs/heads/main$' --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com ghcr.io/confighub/packages/longhorn@sha256:617b2aa407c54c4a645624bbc05a1e4cf3aa44c762684e06d6ba4bfebaebb6b5`. The `packages/...` path is the repo source path
used by maintainers and proof scripts. The proof path compares regular Helm
output with real `cub installer setup` output and explains every intentional
difference, such as the Namespace support object or separated Secrets.
